# vuejs/core [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/vue.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/vue) [![build status](https://github.com/vuejs/core/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/vuejs/core/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Download](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/vue)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/vue) ## Getting Started Please follow the documentation at [vuejs.org](https://vuejs.org/)! ## Sponsors Vue.js is an MIT-licensed open source project with its ongoing development made possible entirely by the support of these awesome [backers](https://github.com/vuejs/core/blob/main/BACKERS.md). If you'd like to join them, please consider [sponsoring Vue's development](https://vuejs.org/sponsor/).

## Questions For questions and support please use [the official forum](https://forum.vuejs.org) or [community chat](https://chat.vuejs.org/).
